title: Products and onboarding
blurb: One Home with attention, Platform ready and product cards; the New product wizard; the Integration page with generated snippets and per-platform Verified; the Platform and Product sidebar contexts.

title: Licenses
blurb: Licenses in an account, waiting or floating; tiers as templates; add-ons; one access policy for who gets a license automatically; limits resolved license, then tier, then platform default.

title: Entitlements, durations and subscriptions
blurb: Named entitlements a device gets from its license; one duration model (lifetime, fixed, trial, version-scoped, renewing, keeps the last version); subscriptions from any provider attached to a license or add-on.

title: Managed config and Cloud Sync
blurb: Settings, secrets and minted tokens in the catalog; Default and per-tier profiles; Editable, Read-only and Hidden; Cloud Sync for user settings and records, with its quota as an entitlement.

title: Release and distribution
blurb: Releases from CI; distribution channels with a page each, storefront tab included; channel wizards with human steps only; rollouts across channels.

title: Packages, release tracks and updates
blurb: Package feeds on pkg.plrs.im; release tracks (stable, beta, dev, custom) and how store testing lanes map from them; updater setup and feeds; packs for games and apps.

title: Commerce
blurb: A service that requires Licensing: offers sold as tiers or add-ons, a SKU per storefront, prices and territories, one purchase ledger and one revocation path.

title: Identity
blurb: One account per person; connections configured once with verified email domains; sign-in surfaces; consent and connected apps; the new-account step with screen name and picture.

title: Administration and access control
blurb: Members, roles and areas; invites and SSO rules; the no-access page that names who can help; personal and service tokens; Platform settings ordered by how often they change.

title: SDKs and UI kits
blurb: polaris-key.json and one start call in six SDKs; doctor() and the CLI flows in the terminal; generated snippets; the must-tier UI kits on their platforms.

title: Customer portal
blurb: The customer's Library, product pages, license cards, devices, sign-in and activation, Discover and storefront links, connected apps and account settings.
